Crop pot rims and selected leaves close, with stems attached to their actual bases; retain a farther taller plant inside the crowded view so small and established plants coexist. The row spacing distinguishes functions without adding labels or dividers. These are substantial readable lines, not a footer. Keep the whole in cool natural greens, warm gray pottery, convincing daylight and crisp planar type. Keep the identifier forceful enough to tell the purpose immediately without turning every line into a headline. Across the central pot rhythm, the right slogan begins the explanatory paragraph. The practical information thus has two different functional homes: identifying/visiting first on the left, understanding/care/actions next on the right. directions.body_end_to_next_info: The last prose line leads directly down the right shared start to access/care; invitation/URL continue immediately there. Identity and schedule were already connected in the first left encounter, and the image's actual pot rims link that start to the right promise/prose.

nearest_peer.structural_distinction: M5 has a left purpose/schedule column and a right promise/prose/care column separated and connected by overhead plant masses that expand into the lower left. M3 has one central continuous purpose-to-prose-to-care route inside side plant silhouettes.
nearest_peer.style_distinction: M5 is expressive gouache seen from above, with pot-rim light and asymmetric canopy masses. M3 is clean flat cut-paper growth silhouette construction with upright attached pots.

image_geometry_concepts.content: Close overhead pots and attached canopy centers, unequal masses and rim rhythm link the two useful reading starts.
Broad lower-left overhead canopy expands where the schedule ends, connected to the middle plant gathering; not a separate image strip.

Coordinates and line counts may change where the actual result preserves conditions, meaningful reading and substantial whole-system distinction.
